{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute mean revenue for completed orders
mean_revenue = df_completed['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Compute mean revenue excluding QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
qa_mask = df_completed['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
mean_revenue_no_qa = df_completed[~qa_mask]['revenue_clean'].mean()

print(f"Mean revenue (including QA): {mean_revenue:.2f}")
print(f"Mean revenue (excluding QA): {mean_revenue_no_qa:.2f}")"}
